jobs.title: Web & Backend Security Analyst
jobs.summary: Assess, identify and help resolve security risks across websites, web applications, APIs and backend systems. Strong practical learners and experienced security professionals are welcome to apply.
jobs.descriptionMd:
We are looking for Web & Backend Security Analysts to support the security of websites, web applications, APIs and backend systems across Fixen Media and selected brands or client projects.

This role focuses on identifying security weaknesses, understanding their impact, communicating findings clearly and helping technical teams improve the security of their systems.

Depending on your experience, you may work on web application reviews, API security, authentication and authorization issues, configuration reviews, vulnerability assessment and post-fix verification.

We welcome candidates from different experience levels. Strong freshers with practical security knowledge, labs, research, CTF experience or demonstrable security work are encouraged to apply. More experienced candidates may take greater ownership of assessments, reporting and remediation guidance.

You are not expected to know every security tool or technique. We value strong fundamentals, ethical judgment, analytical thinking and practical problem-solving ability.
jobs.responsibilitiesMd:
- Review websites, web applications, APIs and backend systems for common security weaknesses.
- Identify issues related to authentication, authorization, access control and session handling.
- Review common web vulnerabilities and security misconfigurations.
- Assess API security and backend exposure where relevant.
- Review security headers, cookies, transport security and related web security configurations.
- Identify outdated or vulnerable dependencies where applicable.
- Document findings clearly with risk, impact and recommended remediation.
- Work with developers to explain vulnerabilities and practical fixes.
- Retest reported issues after remediation.
- Support basic WordPress or CMS security reviews where required.
- Maintain ethical and authorized testing practices at all times.
- Experienced candidates may take ownership of structured assessments, severity classification and security reporting.
jobs.requirementsMd:
- Good understanding of web application security fundamentals.
- Familiarity with OWASP Top 10.
- Understanding of HTTP, cookies, sessions and authentication.
- Basic knowledge of APIs and backend application behavior.
- Ability to identify and explain common security issues.
- Familiarity with at least one web security testing or inspection tool.
- Understanding of authorization and access-control concepts.
- Ability to document technical findings clearly.
- Strong ethical judgment and respect for authorization boundaries.
- Willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies.
- Practical evidence of learning or work through labs, CTFs, research, projects or assessments.

Formal employment experience is not mandatory for candidates demonstrating strong practical knowledge.
jobs.niceToHaveMd:
- Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP or similar tools
- API security testing
- JWT, session-based authentication and RBAC
- Linux and command-line knowledge
- Nmap, Postman or dependency scanners
- WordPress security assessments
- Bug bounty, CTF, Hack The Box or TryHackMe experience
- Security assessment reporting
- Secure coding practices
- Server, deployment or cloud security reviews
- Relevant training or certifications
benefits: Work on real web and application security scenarios
Exposure to different technology stacks and products
Opportunity to collaborate directly with developers
Growth through practical security assessment experience
